title: NCUC Docket E-100, SUB 101 — Order Granting Further Extension Of Time
text:
STATE OF NORTH CAROLINA 
UTILITIES COMMISSION 
RALEIGH 
DOCKET NO. E-100, SUB 101 
BEFORE THE NORTH CAROLINA UTILITIES COMMISSION 
In the Matter of 
Petition for Approval of Revisions to 
Generator Interconnection Standards 
) 
) 
ORDER GRANTING FURTHER 
EXTENSION OF TIME 
BY THE CHAIR: On April 20, 2021, the Commission issued an Order Granting 
Further Extension of time for parties to file reply comments regarding the generator 
inspection provisions of the North Carolina Generator Interconnection Standard. The 
Order allowed parties to reply comments on or before May 26, 2021. 
On May 20, 2021, Strata Solar, LLC and Strata Solar Development, LLC (together, 
Strata) and Duke Energy Carolinas, LLC, and Duke Energy Progress, LLC (together, 
Duke) filed a motion requesting a further extension of time to file reply comments on the 
issues related to the generator inspection provisions of the North Carolina Generator 
Interconnection Standard. In the motion, Strata and Duke requested an additional 30 days 
to file reply comments in order to continue discussion and attempt to reach resolution on 
these issues. The motion stated that Strata and Duke have been engaged in discussions 
and expect to reach a settlement within the requested 30-day extension period. The 
motion further stated that the Carolinas Clean Energy Business Association and the 
Public Staff do not object to the requested extension of time. 
Based on the motion, the Chair finds good cause to grant the extension for parties 
to file reply comments generator inspection provisions of the North Carolina Generator 
Interconnection Standard. Parties may file reply comments on or before June 25, 2021. 
IT IS, THEREFORE, SO ORDERED. 
ISSUED BY ORDER OF THE COMMISSION. 
This the 21st day of May, 2021. 
NORTH CAROLINA UTILITIES COMMISSION 

A. Shonta Dunston, Deputy Clerk
